Description.English: Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, northerly winds will occasionally reach force 6 with gusts, and temperature will drop slightly. The weather is expected to be cool with some light rain patches on Wednesday and Thursday (25th and 26th Nov), with minimum temperature around 15 degrees Celsius. The public is advised to pay attention to the weather changes and take appropriate measures. Additionally, due to astronomical tides in the coming days, seawater inundation is expected within the Inner Harbor area on Wednesday(25th Nov) night. The public are advised to pay attention. ( Update Time: 2026-11-24 17H30 )
